items.t: IREN says Horizon 1 delivered 22% faster than industry benchmark
items.sum: Microsoft accepted Horizon 1 in August. Revenue timing now depends on Horizons 2 through 4, which slipped after a network redesign and won't contribute materially until early 2027.

items.t: IREN: A Liquidity Crisis Is Brewing
items.sum: IREN is downgraded to a Strong Sell considering its $6 billion funding gap is about 70% of market cap and could spark a liquidity crisis and wipe out equity.

items.t: Nebius Tumbles 14% on Soft Guidance and Bigger Spending Plans; CoreWeave Sinks 10%, IREN Drops 7%
items.sum: A softer outlook and far bigger spending plans are overshadowing a strong quarter at Nebius Group (NASDAQ:NBIS). Nebius stock is at $133.67 in morning trading, down 14%. items.t: Why Is IREN Stock Falling on Thursday?
items.sum: IREN stock falls Thursday after Jensen Huang's immediate resignation as Nvidia CEO, adding to pressure on AI infrastructure stocks from midterm ballot measures restricting data centers.

items.t: IREN: The Market Is Way Too Pessimistic
items.sum: IREN Ltd. (IREN) beat Q1 FY27 estimates, as AI cloud revenue nearly tripled to $200M and adjusted EBITDA margin doubled to 29%.
